svg.title: Exploded Art-Net diagnostics and performance tuning stack
svg.desc: Four large isometric layers show network arrival, frame integrity, output scheduling and DMA/physical output. A luminous vertical spine links the stages; a side diagnostic flow traces counters and a grounded tuning rail presents controlled experiments. High packet rate alone cannot prove complete frame assembly.

g.text: Trace the signal through the stack.
Follow the first layer that stops advancing; tune only after the evidence points to it.
890 pkt/s alone cannot prove a complete frame.
CHANGE ONE VARIABLE · REPEAT THE SAME MEASUREMENT
Spread packet bursts · 100 µs was not a universal fix
Measure RX queue · CPU gaps · frame age
Longer runs + frame IDs · CRC and optical checks
Validate routing and payload size before changing buffers. A larger ring remains an unmeasured candidate.
